overview.startPoint: Speak to Irena, the woman crying at the Shantay Pass, south of Al Kharid.

required.note: Items from the tool belt are not listed unless they do not work or are not automatically added.

items.html: Desert shirt, desert robe, and desert boots (Black variants will not work. You may purchase from Shantay Pass Shop during the quest.)
items.text: Desert shirt, desert robe, and desert boots (Black variants will not work. You may purchase from Shantay Pass Shop during the quest.)

items.html: 10 feathers (You can only use regular feathers. You may purchase from Shantay Pass Shop during the quest.)
items.text: 10 feathers (You can only use regular feathers. You may purchase from Shantay Pass Shop during the quest.)

items.html: Bronze bar (The bar must be in your inventory.)
items.text: Bronze bar (The bar must be in your inventory.)

items.html: At least 200 coins (or 100 with ring of charos (a))
items.text: At least 200 coins (or 100 with ring of charos (a))

items.html: Protection from desert heat, at least 2-3 full waterskins, an enchanted water tiara, or completion of Crocodile Tears
items.text: Protection from desert heat, at least 2-3 full waterskins, an enchanted water tiara, or completion of Crocodile Tears

items.html: Weapons and armour for lower combat level players
items.text: Weapons and armour for lower combat level players

items.html: At least 15 backpack spaces - you will need to remove all worn items and still have room in your backpack for up to 7 quest items
items.text: At least 15 backpack spaces - you will need to remove all worn items and still have room in your backpack for up to 7 quest items

blocks.html: If you don't have desert clothes, buy them from Shantay.
blocks.text: If you don't have desert clothes, buy them from Shantay.

blocks.html: Begin the quest by talking to Irena (south of Shantay Pass).
blocks.text: Begin the quest by talking to Irena (south of Shantay Pass).

options.text: What's the matter?
When did she go into the desert?
I'll look for your daughter.
Okay Irena, calm down. I'll get your daughter back for you.
[Accept Quest]

blocks.html: Run south and slightly west to the gate of the Desert Mining Camp.
blocks.text: Run south and slightly west to the gate of the Desert Mining Camp.

blocks.html: Making sure not to attack him, talk to Mercenary Captain (the one with the all-grey shield).
blocks.text: Making sure not to attack him, talk to Mercenary Captain (the one with the all-grey shield).

options.text: Wow! A real captain!
I'd love to work for a tough guy like you!
Can't I do something for a strong Captain like you?
Sorry Sir, I don't think I can do that.
It's a funny captain who can't fight his own battles!

blocks.html: Kill the Mercenary Captain to obtain a metal key.
blocks.text: Kill the Mercenary Captain to obtain a metal key.

substeps.html: The metal key can be added to the steel key ring after One Small Favour.
substeps.text: The metal key can be added to the steel key ring after One Small Favour.

blocks.html: Unequip all armour (includes amulets, rings, etc.) and weapons, and keep them unequipped whenever inside the mining camp or mine.
blocks.text: Unequip all armour (includes amulets, rings, etc.) and weapons, and keep them unequipped whenever inside the mining camp or mine.

blocks.html: Open the gate to enter the camp.
blocks.text: Open the gate to enter the camp.

blocks.html: Go east to the mine door entrance and talk to the male slave on the east of the camp (it's the one who never mines).
blocks.text: Go east to the mine door entrance and talk to the male slave on the east of the camp (it's the one who never mines).

options.text: I've just arrived.
Oh yes, that sounds interesting.
What's that then?
I can try to undo them for you.
It's funny you should say that...
Yeah, okay, let's give it a go.
Yes, I'll trade.

substeps.html: If a guard catches you unlocking the slave's chains and you end up in the cell, bend the bars on the window and escape. Talk to the slave to try again.
substeps.text: If a guard catches you unlocking the slave's chains and you end up in the cell, bend the bars on the window and escape. Talk to the slave to try again.

blocks.html: While wearing the slave outfit, open the mine door entrance. The outfit must be equipped any time you enter the mine.
blocks.text: While wearing the slave outfit, open the mine door entrance. The outfit must be equipped any time you enter the mine.

blocks.html: Upon entering, head north and follow the cave around until you come to a guarded cave entrance.
blocks.text: Upon entering, head north and follow the cave around until you come to a guarded cave entrance.

blocks.html: Making sure not to attack him, talk to one of the guards.
blocks.text: Making sure not to attack him, talk to one of the guards.

options.text: I'd like to mine in a different area.
Yes sir, you're quite right sir.
Yes sir, we understand each other perfectly.

blocks.html: Head back to the mine doors and exit.
blocks.text: Head back to the mine doors and exit.

blocks.html: Unequip your slave clothing and leave the Desert Mining Camp through the gate.
blocks.text: Unequip your slave clothing and leave the Desert Mining Camp through the gate.

blocks.html: Run west to the Bedabin Camp.
blocks.text: Run west to the Bedabin Camp.

blocks.html: Talk to Al Shabim in the southernmost tent to receive the Bedabin key.
blocks.text: Talk to Al Shabim in the southernmost tent to receive the Bedabin key.

options.text: I am looking for a pineapple.
Yes, I'm interested.

blocks.html: Run east back to the Desert Mining Camp and climb up the ladder in the white building.
blocks.text: Run east back to the Desert Mining Camp and climb up the ladder in the white building.

blocks.html: On the western wall search the south-western bookcase for a book on sailing.
blocks.text: On the western wall search the south-western bookcase for a book on sailing.

blocks.html: Talk to Captain Siad in the same room and ask him if you can chat with him, then mention the sailing book.
blocks.text: Talk to Captain Siad in the same room and ask him if you can chat with him, then mention the sailing book.

options.text: I wanted to have a chat?
You seem to have a lot of books!
So, you're interested in sailing?
I could tell by the cut of your jib.

blocks.html: Open the chest beside the table to get the plans.
blocks.text: Open the chest beside the table to get the plans.

blocks.html: Go back to the Bedabin Camp and show Al Shabim the plans.
blocks.text: Go back to the Bedabin Camp and show Al Shabim the plans.

options.text: Yes, I'm very interested.
Yes, I'm kind of curious.

blocks.html: Enter the tent to the north.
blocks.text: Enter the tent to the north.

blocks.html: Use the experimental anvil with a bronze bar in your inventory and answer the prompt to create a prototype dart tip.
blocks.text: Use the experimental anvil with a bronze bar in your inventory and answer the prompt to create a prototype dart tip.

options.text: Yes. I'd like to try.

blocks.html: Use a feather on the dart tip to make a prototype dart.
blocks.text: Use a feather on the dart tip to make a prototype dart.

blocks.html: Take this back to Al Shabim. He will take the prototype dart, technical plans, and Bedabin key in exchange for a bronze dart and Tenti pineapple.
blocks.text: Take this back to Al Shabim. He will take the prototype dart, technical plans, and Bedabin key in exchange for a bronze dart and Tenti pineapple.

blocks.html: Wear the slave outfit, head back down into the mine and give the pineapple to one of the guards.
blocks.text: Wear the slave outfit, head back down into the mine and give the pineapple to one of the guards.

blocks.html: Walk through the mine cave and run east to the mine cart.
blocks.text: Walk through the mine cave and run east to the mine cart.

blocks.html: Choose "Search" option on one of the empty barrels nearby and answer the prompt to take it.
blocks.text: Choose "Search" option on one of the empty barrels nearby and answer the prompt to take it.

options.text: Yeah, cool!

blocks.html: Choose "Search" option on the mine cart to ride it to the other side, answering the prompt to confirm.
blocks.text: Choose "Search" option on the mine cart to ride it to the other side, answering the prompt to confirm.

options.text: Yes, of course.

substeps.html: Failing to enter the cart will cause minor damage. If you fail, attempt to enter the cart again.
substeps.text: Failing to enter the cart will cause minor damage. If you fail, attempt to enter the cart again.

blocks.html: Go down the northwestern passageway containing a large number of slaves at the end and you will find Ana.
blocks.text: Go down the northwestern passageway containing a large number of slaves at the end and you will find Ana.

blocks.html: Use the barrel in your inventory on Ana to squeeze her inside it, and head back to the mine cart.
blocks.text: Use the barrel in your inventory on Ana to squeeze her inside it, and head back to the mine cart.

blocks.html: Use Ana on the mine cart first, then ride it yourself when it comes back.
blocks.text: Use Ana on the mine cart first, then ride it yourself when it comes back.

options.text: Yes, of course.

blocks.html: Search the barrels around the cart and retrieve the one that has Ana in it.
blocks.text: Search the barrels around the cart and retrieve the one that has Ana in it.

blocks.html: Use the winch bucket north-west of the cart to put the barrel on it.
blocks.text: Use the winch bucket north-west of the cart to put the barrel on it.

blocks.html: Accept the guard's offer for help and give him a compliment.
blocks.text: Accept the guard's offer for help and give him a compliment.

options.text: Yes please.
I said you were very gregarious!

blocks.html: Head back to the surface and go to the winch bucket in the south-western corner of the camp.
blocks.text: Head back to the surface and go to the winch bucket in the south-western corner of the camp.

substeps.html: Do not remove your slave clothes at any point.
substeps.text: Do not remove your slave clothes at any point.

blocks.html: Operate it and then search the barrel west of it.
blocks.text: Operate it and then search the barrel west of it.

blocks.html: Use Ana on the wooden cart at the centre of the camp.
blocks.text: Use Ana on the wooden cart at the centre of the camp.

blocks.html: Talk to the Mine-cart driver. (Warning: If you use the wrong responses you'll have to rescue Ana again!)
blocks.text: Talk to the Mine-cart driver. (Warning: If you use the wrong responses you'll have to rescue Ana again!)

options.text: Nice cart.
One wagon wheel says to the other, 'I'll see you around'.
'One good turn deserves another'
Fired... no, shot perhaps!
In for a penny in for a pound.
Well, you see, it's like this...
Prison riot in ten minutes, get your cart out of here!
You can't leave me here, I'll get killed!

substeps.html: If you fail, you need to head back into the deepest part of the mine with a barrel and get Ana out again.
substeps.text: If you fail, you need to head back into the deepest part of the mine with a barrel and get Ana out again.

blocks.html: Search the cart and answer the prompt to get on.
blocks.text: Search the cart and answer the prompt to get on.

options.text: Yes, I'll get on.

blocks.html: Run north-east towards Shantay Pass and talk to Irena.
blocks.text: Run north-east towards Shantay Pass and talk to Irena.

blocks.html: Congratulations, quest complete!
blocks.text: Congratulations, quest complete!

items.html: 4,650 experience in your choice of two from the following skills (you may pick the same skill twice): Agility, Fletching, Smithing or Thieving
items.text: 4,650 experience in your choice of two from the following skills (you may pick the same skill twice): Agility, Fletching, Smithing or Thieving

items.html: Ability to smith darts
A wrought iron key for access to the Desert Mining Camp and the cave beneath it (can be added to the steel key ring after One Small Favour)
items.text: A wrought iron key for access to the Desert Mining Camp and the cave beneath it (can be added to the steel key ring after One Small Favour)
